T1 AUDIT COMPLETE — Consumer Migration Map

All callers of completion-verifier across plugins/dso/skills/*.md were audited for overall_verdict and P1 field usage.

MIGRATION STATUS:
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md: MIGRATED (S1). All verdict reads use P1 typed-enum. References: Phase F Step 18 (P1: PASS → proceed, non-PASS → Phase C), Phase G Step 2 (Gate 1 = check-verifier-verdict.sh). No overall_verdict reads found.
- plugins/dso/skills/end-session/SKILL.md: MIGRATED (S1). Line 50 reads P1: PASS (schema_version=2) with explicit backward-compat: 'overall_verdict: PASS (schema_version=1, backward-compat)' fallback documented inline.
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-verifier-verdict.sh: Shell consumer. Reads P1 directly from JSON; exits 0 for PASS, 1 for FAIL/BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE, 2 for absent/malformed. Does NOT read overall_verdict.
- plugins/dso/scripts/render-closure-narrative.sh: Shell consumer. Reads P1 field and criteria_results to produce deterministic output. Does NOT read overall_verdict.
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md: OUT OF SCOPE — does not dispatch completion-verifier.
- plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md: OUT OF SCOPE — does not directly call completion-verifier (sprint orchestrates it).

FILES STILL READING overall_verdict WITHOUT P1 CHECK: NONE.

BACKWARD-COMPAT SHIM STATUS:
- end-session SKILL.md: backward-compat explicitly documented inline (schema_version=1 → overall_verdict fallback).
- sprint SKILL.md: all verdict reads go through check-verifier-verdict.sh which exits 2 for absent P1 (schema_version=1 payloads). No explicit schema_version branch in SKILL.md; the shell script is the parser.
- Contract verifier-verdict.md: defines the canonical parsing rule (schema_version >= 2 → P1, else overall_verdict).

FINDINGS FOR T3: Both consumers are already migrated. T3 job is to verify backward-compat shim documentation is present and consistent.
